observations: At native 320x300, the bright structure has a curved or ring-like upper part around a dark centre and a broad vertical bright stroke continuing downward through the central area. It is compatible with the published phi reference; it is substantially more informative than the incomplete 96x96 pair crop.
The image is blurred, strokes are broad, and there is a black masked boundary near the top. I do not independently establish an exact letter transcription from this probability image alone.
decision_scope: Adequate as a fixed known-location visual reference for the separately planned approximate-input screening experiment. The local known-phi output must be reviewed against this before accepting an unknown region for raw-CT followup. This is not proof of novel text, same-sheet attribution, general accuracy, or exact reproduction.
